name: Minamoto no Motomi
source:
One of the Eight Guardians. 
He acts as the Genbu of Heaven for his era's White Dragon Priestess. 
Family: Retired Emperor (father), mother, Emperor (older half-brother), Akifumi (younger half-brother)
Occupation: Chief judge of the Ministry of Civil Services
Innate Element: Water
Weapon(s): Prayer beads
Specialties: Playing the flute
Hobbies: Creating musical compositions
Favorite Scent: Kuroubou
Favorite Color: Aisumicha (medium gray)
Favorite Flower(s): Chrysanthemum (autumn) / Heavenly bamboo (winter)

[From [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_2]Koei Wiki[/url]]
